name: Chu Fu
bio: Chu Fu (朱服; Zhu Fu; 1048–1102) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 渔家傲 (Yu jia ao)
poems.author: Chu Fu
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
小雨廉纤风细细。
万家杨柳轻烟里。
恋树湿花飞不起。
愁无比。
和春付与西流水。
九十光阴能有几。
金龟解尽留无计。
寄语东城沽酒市。
拼一醉。
而今乐事他年泪。
